children: Alistithmar Capital, the investment banking arm of the Saudi Investment Bank, said on Monday that it has acquired the Jeddah Cove project in Saudi Arabia.
The investment bank has launched a SAR 1.1 billion fund to take over and finance the commercial and entertainment destination, along with master developer Ezdihar Real Estate Development Company.
The Jeddah Cove project spans an area of around 140,000 square metres on the Jeddah corniche.
Set for completion in 2027, Jeddah Cove is designed to house more than 200 retail shops and dining venues.
(Writing by Cleofe Maceda; editing by Seban Scaria) seban.scaria@lseg.com

title: Saudi’s Alistithmar Capital acquires Jeddah Cove project
